description_en: Queries the operation log records of a user
description_zh: 查询用户的操作日志记录
name: DescribeUserLog

parameters.help_en: The short title of the item
parameters.name: item_short_title

parameters.help_en:
The log type. Valid values:

`OPERATION_TYPE_BIND`: ESL binding.

`OPERATION_TYPE_UNBIND`: ESL unbinding.

`OPERATION_TYPE_FORCE_UPDATE`: ESL refresh - manual refresh.

`OPERATION_TYPE_ITEM_CHANGE_UPDATE`: ESL refresh - item update.

`OPERATION_TYPE_ALL_UPDATE`: ESL refresh - store-level refresh.

`OPERATION_TYPE_SEND_FAILED_RETRY`: Operation retry - send failed.

`OPERATION_TYPE_DISPLAY_FAILED_RETRY`: Operation retry - display failed.

`OPERATION_TYPE_LIGHT_UP_ESL_LED`: ESL LED light-up
parameters.help_zh:
日志类型，可选值：

`OPERATION_TYPE_BIND`：价签绑定

`OPERATION_TYPE_UNBIND`：价签解绑

`OPERATION_TYPE_FORCE_UPDATE`：价签刷新 - 主动刷新

`OPERATION_TYPE_ITEM_CHANGE_UPDATE`：价签刷新 - 商品更新

`OPERATION_TYPE_ALL_UPDATE`：价签刷新 - 门店级刷新

`OPERATION_TYPE_SEND_FAILED_RETRY`：操作重试 - 发送失败

`OPERATION_TYPE_DISPLAY_FAILED_RETRY`：操作重试 - 显示失败

`OPERATION_TYPE_LIGHT_UP_ESL_LED`：价签亮灯
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying operation logs. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询操作日志：开始时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.help_en: The store ID or custom store ID defined by the merchant
parameters.help_zh: 门店ID或商家自定义门店ID
parameters.name: store_id

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying operation logs. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询操作日志：结束时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数，默认值10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The log status. Valid values:

`OPERATION_STATUS_NEW`: new.

`OPERATION_STATUS_SENT`: sent.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DISPLAY`: displayed.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DELETE`: deleted.

`OPERATION_STATUS_BREAK`: interrupted.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DEVICE_RETRY_DISPLAY`: retrying.

`OPERATION_STATUS_SEND_FAILED`: send failed.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DISPLAY_FAILED`: display failed
parameters.help_zh:

OperationStatus.description_en:
The log status. Valid values:

`OPERATION_STATUS_NEW`: new operation.

`OPERATION_STATUS_SENT`: send operation.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DISPLAY`: completed operation.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DELETE`: delete operation.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DEVICE_RETRY_DISPLAY`: retry operation.

`OPERATION_STATUS_SEND_FAILED`: send failed.

`OPERATION_STATUS_DISPLAY_FAILED`: refresh failed
OperationStatus.description_zh:
日志状态，返回值对应关系：

`OPERATION_STATUS_NEW`：新建操作

`OPERATION_STATUS_SENT`：发送操作

`OPERATION_STATUS_DISPLAY`：完成操作

`OPERATION_STATUS_DELETE`：删除操作

`OPERATION_STATUS_DEVICE_RETRY_DISPLAY`：重试操作

`OPERATION_STATUS_SEND_FAILED`：发送失败

`OPERATION_STATUS_DISPLAY_FAILED`：刷新失败

OperationType.description_en:
The log type. Valid values:

`OPERATION_TYPE_BIND`: ESL binding.

`OPERATION_TYPE_UNBIND`: ESL unbinding.

`OPERATION_TYPE_FORCE_UPDATE`: ESL refresh - manual refresh.

`OPERATION_TYPE_ITEM_CHANGE_UPDATE`: ESL refresh - item update.

`OPERATION_TYPE_ALL_UPDATE`: ESL refresh - store-level refresh.

`OPERATION_TYPE_SEND_FAILED_RETRY`: Operation retry - send failed.

`OPERATION_TYPE_DISPLAY_FAILED_RETRY`: Operation retry - display failed.

`OPERATION_TYPE_TIMEOUT_RETRY`: Operation retry - operation timeout.

`OPERATION_TYPE_ESL_NOT_FOUND_RETRY`: Operation retry - unknown device.

`OPERATION_TYPE_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND_RETRY`: Operation retry - unknown template.

`OPERATION_TYPE_DRAW_PICTURE_FAILED_RETRY`: Operation retry - abnormal template.

`OPERATION_TYPE_BATCH_TIMES_DIRECTIONAL_REFRESH`: ESL refresh - item import.

`OPERATION_TYPE_ON_LINE_RETRY`: ESL refresh - online retry.

`OPERATION_TYPE_LIGHT_UP_ESL_LED`: LED light-up
